ui.chat.inline_chart.also.role: lead-in before a one-line list of pie slices too small to label on the chart
ui.chat.inline_chart.also.length: One or two words; followed by items like 'A 2.1%, B 0.8%'.
ui.chat.inline_chart.also.note: Meta-size text under a donut chart in a chat answer.

ui.chat.inline_chart.data_toggle.role: button that expands the exact values behind an inline chart as a table
ui.chat.inline_chart.data_toggle.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no verb
ui.chat.inline_chart.data_toggle.length: Two or three words; sits under the chart beside a chevron.
ui.chat.inline_chart.data_toggle.note: Collapsed by default. The same label ships on the mobile app and the relay web viewer, keep it a short noun phrase.

ui.chat.inline_chart.more.role: suffix in a pie chart tooltip after up to eight folded items, counting the rest
ui.chat.inline_chart.more.note: Shown in the tooltip of the 'Other' slice.

placeholders.count: number of further items not listed

ui.chat.inline_chart.no_data.role: tooltip for a heatmap cell whose value is missing
ui.chat.inline_chart.no_data.note: The cell is drawn hatched instead of filled.

ui.chat.inline_chart.other.role: label of the pie chart slice that groups the smallest items
ui.chat.inline_chart.other.length: Short; appears as a slice label, legend row and tooltip heading.
ui.chat.inline_chart.other.note: Pie charts with more than seven items keep the six largest and fold the rest into this slice.

placeholders.count: how many items were folded into the slice

ui.chat.inline_chart.pair.role: one line of a scatter-plot tooltip pairing an axis name with a value
ui.chat.inline_chart.pair.note: Follow the locale's colon spacing convention.

placeholders.label: axis name authored by the assistant, e.g. 'Response time (ms)'

ui.chat.inline_chart.position.role: screen-reader position of the focused chart mark within its series
ui.chat.inline_chart.position.note: Read aloud after the mark's label and value, e.g. 'Nov 18, Spend, 140.61 USD, 3 of 9'.

ui.chat.inline_chart.right_axis.role: chart legend entry for a series plotted against the right-hand axis
ui.chat.inline_chart.right_axis.length: Label plus two or three words.
ui.chat.inline_chart.right_axis.note: Dual-axis charts draw the right-axis series dashed; this names which axis it reads against.

placeholders.label: series name authored by the assistant, e.g. 'Latency'

ui.chat.inline_chart.role.role: accessible role description announced for an inline chart
ui.chat.inline_chart.role.tone: lowercase common noun, as screen readers announce role names
ui.chat.inline_chart.role.note: Used as aria-roledescription, so a screen reader says e.g. 'Revenue by region, chart'.

ui.chat.inline_chart.share_of_total.role: tooltip line giving a mark's share of the whole
ui.chat.inline_chart.share_of_total.note: Shown for pie slices, percent and stacked bars, e.g. '38.2% of total'.

placeholders.share: formatted percentage including its percent sign

ui.chat.inline_chart.total.role: label for a sum: the centre of a donut at rest and the last row of a stacked-bar tooltip
